story.姓名學的流派很多，筆畫算法和 81 數理表都有不同版本。這裡用康熙筆畫，兩個數理: Name analysis has many schools, with different ways of counting strokes and different versions of the 81-number table. This uses the Kangxi dictionary's stroke counts, and counts a number as half-favourable when the two tables disagree. The Heaven Grid is the surname handed down by your ancestors, so most schools do not read it as good or bad. A name tilts the odds by 5% at most, and never affects lifespan or serious illness.
